raw_text:
`content/`: keep `_index.de.md` and `_index.en.md` siblings with mirrored front matter; sync `title`, `date`, `draft`, `weight`, `archetype`. Extend `layouts/partials/` and `layouts/shortcodes/`, not `themes/hugo-theme-relearn`. Use `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css` for styling, `static/` for pass-through files; refresh `public/` / `resources/` only via `hugo --cleanDestinationDir`. Store diagrams in `svg/` or beside pages. Use Hugo Extended v0.120+, YAML front matter, ISO timestamps, `#` titles, `##`/`###` sections, lowercase filenames and domain folders. Use existing shortcodes (`{{% notice %}}`, `{{< svg icon="..." >}}`).

Preview: `hugo server --disableFastRender -D --buildFuture --navigateToChanged`; snapshots: `hugo server --renderToDisk --printUnusedTemplates`; deploy: `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings --cleanDestinationDir`. Run `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings` before every commit. Add `--i18n-warnings --printUnusedTranslations --printPathWarnings`. Check `public/search/index.json` and affected pages in Chromium and Firefox. Use focused imperative commits; include regenerated `public/` when published output changes. PRs: list touched sections, link issues, attach styling previews, and report whether `hugo --gc --minify` ran clean.
